en: The [[concert]] [[was canceled]] because of a thunderstorm hitting the country, leaving thousands of fans disappointed outside the arena.
me: because of a thunderstorm hitting the country,
leaving thousands of fans disappointed outside the arena.
easy: because of a thunderstorm hitting the country
leaving thousands of fans disappointed outside the arena
수천 명의 팬들을 경기장 밖에서 실망한 채로 남겨 두면서.
요약: 뇌우 때문에 콘서트가 취소되어 팬들이 실망했다.
notes: 감정을 느끼는 쪽 = 과거분사(-ed), 감정을 일으키는 쪽 = 현재분사(-ing). 팬들은 실망을 '느끼니까' disappointed(실망한)
leave(남겨 두다) A B = A를 B인 채로 두다 → B 자리에 형용사나 분사가 온다

en: The [[parents]] [[sat]] and [[enjoyed]] [[a conversation]] while their children played in the park, a peaceful routine that always brings them closer as a family.
me: while their children played in the park,
a peaceful routine that always brings them closer as a family.
easy: The parents sat and enjoyed a conversation
while their children played in the park
a peaceful routine that always brings them closer as a family
그들을 가족으로서 항상 더 가깝게 만들어 주는 평화로운 일상.
요약: 아이들이 놀 때 부모가 대화하는 일상이 가족을 더 가깝게 해 준다.
notes: 관계대명사절의 동사는 선행사에 수일치: 선행사 a peaceful routine(평화로운 일상)이 단수 → bring(가져오다)이 아니라 brings
콤마 뒤 명사(a peaceful routine)는 앞 내용을 다시 설명해 주는 말이고, that 이하가 그 명사를 꾸민다

en: Despite heavy traffic on the city roads, [[Sarah]] [[arrived]] at the meeting on time, feeling proud of herself as she had planned every minute of her commute.
me: Despite heavy traffic on the city roads,
feeling proud of herself as she had planned every minute of her commute.
easy: Despite heavy traffic on the city roads
도시 도로의 극심한 교통 체증에도 불구하고.
feeling proud of herself as she had planned every minute of her commute
통근의 매 순간을 계획해 둔 것처럼 스스로가 자랑스러워하며.
요약: Sarah는 교통 체증에도 제시간에 도착해 뿌듯했다.
notes: like는 전치사(뒤에 명사만), as는 전치사 + 접속사(뒤에 주어+동사 가능). 뒤에 절(she had planned)이 오면 as
Despite + 명사(구) = ~에도 불구하고 (뒤에 절이 오지 않는다)

en: Though the dog barked loudly, [[it]] [[didn't bother]] [[the neighbors]], although it continued barking well into the night without any sign of stopping.
me: although it continued barking well into the night without any sign of stopping.
easy: although it continued barking well into the night
비록 그 개가 밤늦게까지 계속 짖었지만.
요약: 개가 밤새 짖었는데도 이웃은 불편해하지 않았다.
notes: although / though + 주어+동사(절), despite + 명사(구). 뒤에 절이 이어지면 although
continue(계속하다) + -ing = 계속 ~하다 (continued barking = 계속 짖었다)

en: [[Ms. Undset]] [[escaped]] [[Norway]] during the German attack, but she returned after WWII, a journey she completed alone back in 1940.
me: a journey she completed alone back in 1940.
easy: a journey she completed alone back in 1940
요약: Undset 여사는 1940년에 홀로 탈출했고 전쟁 후 돌아왔다.
notes: in 1940, yesterday, ago처럼 분명한 과거 시점 표현이 있으면 현재완료가 아니라 단순과거. 예: I finished it in 1940.
a journey 뒤의 she completed는 '그녀가 끝낸'이라고 앞 명사 journey(여정)를 꾸민다 (that이 생략된 형태)

en: [[I]] [[moved]] to this city in 2010, and since that year, I have witnessed its remarkable growth, though I am still not sure what changes matter the most to my neighbors.
me: and since that year, I have witnessed its remarkable growth,
though I am still not sure what changes matter the most to my neighbors.
easy: since that year, I have witnessed its remarkable growth
그 해 이래로 나는 이 도시의 눈부신 성장을 지켜봐 왔다.
though I am still not sure what changes matter the most to my neighbors
비록 어떤 변화가 이웃들에게 가장 중요한지는 여전히 확신하지 못하지만.
요약: 2010년 이사 온 뒤 도시의 성장을 봐 왔지만, 무엇이 가장 중요한지는 아직 모른다.
notes: that은 뒤에 완전한 절, what은 뒤가 불완전한 절(주어나 목적어가 빠짐). 여기서는 what이 와서 '어떤 변화가 ~인지'가 된다
since ~(~이래로)가 나오면 현재완료와 잘 짝을 이룬다 (have witnessed = 지켜봐 왔다, witness(목격하다))

en: The [[students]] [[celebrated]] by going out for dinner after they finished the college entrance exams, a tradition that has been celebrated by nearly every graduating class at their school.
me: by going out for dinner after they finished the college entrance exams,
a tradition that has been celebrated by nearly every graduating class at their school.
easy: by going out for dinner after they finished the college entrance exams
대입 시험을 마친 후 저녁을 먹으러 나감으로써.
a tradition that has been celebrated by nearly every graduating class
거의 모든 졸업반이 기념해 온 전통.
요약: 시험이 끝나면 저녁을 먹으며 자축하는 건 오랜 전통이다.
notes: 주어가 동작을 '당하면' 수동태(be + p.p.): 전통(tradition)은 기념하는 쪽이 아니라 기념되는 쪽 → has been celebrated(기념되어 왔다) + by ~
by + -ing = ~함으로써 (by going out = 나감으로써, go out(나가다))

en: With the same green eyes and red hair, [[Natalie]] [[looks like her mother]], a resemblance that grows stronger as she grows older each year.
me: With the same green eyes and red hair,
a resemblance that grows stronger as she grows older each year.
easy: With the same green eyes and red hair
as she grows older each year
요약: Natalie는 나이 들수록 어머니를 더 닮아 간다.
notes: 비교급 만들기: 짧은(1음절) 형용사는 -er (old → older(더 나이 든)), 긴 형용사는 more + 원급 (beautiful → more beautiful). old에 more를 붙이면 ✕
grow + 형용사 = ~해지다 (grows stronger = 더 강해진다)

en: [[We]] [[worked]] hard until the late hours of the night to complete the project successfully, though nobody could say what caused the biggest delay in the process.
me: hard until the late hours of the night to complete the project successfully,
though nobody could say what caused the biggest delay in the process.
easy: hard until the late hours of the night to complete the project successfully
though nobody could say what caused the biggest delay in the process
비록 무엇이 과정에서 가장 큰 지연을 일으켰는지는 아무도 말하지 못했지만.
요약: 밤늦게까지 일해 프로젝트를 끝냈지만, 지연의 원인은 아무도 몰랐다.
notes: what + 동사(주어가 빠진 불완전한 절) = 무엇이 ~했는지. if는 '~인지 아닌지'이며 뒤에 완전한 절이 와야 한다
to + 동사원형 = ~하기 위해 (to complete = 완성하기 위해, complete(완성하다))

en: [[People]] naturally [[get]] [[used to things around them]] as time passes, embracing what comes next in their daily routine.
me: embracing what comes next in their daily routine.
easy: embracing what comes next in their daily routine
요약: 사람들은 시간이 지나면 일상에서 다음에 오는 것도 받아들인다.
notes: what = ~하는 것(앞에 꾸밀 명사가 필요 없음). 꾸밀 명사(선행사) 없이 '~하는 것'이면 which ✕ what
get used to + 명사 = ~에 익숙해지다
